chosenApproach: Keep small BannerAd native SDK visible during initial load/no-fill while limiting Animated opacity to the Sponsored label. Mount the large BannerAd fallback only after the existing shared passive-request reservation succeeds. Preserve reserved slot geometry and AdMob automatic refresh opportunity. selectionRationale: Minimally removes hidden-SDK and reservation-order risks; doesn't inflate ad requests, introduce native modules or alter user experience beyond ad rendering. Keeps the cumulative OTA separate from this PR.
alternativeApproaches: Force small banners to retry until they win the race: rejected; would increase no-fill rate and request spam without guaranteed inventory.
Delay or block large native sponsored creatives until the small banner is served: rejected; would create artificial priority, lose valid impressions, and worsen perceived responsiveness.
Use native SDK-visible surfaces and enforce request reservation on both formats: selected.
